factions.name: The Authority (BLKOUT)
factions.source: BLKOUT 2nd Ed. (Enemy Spotted Studios), converted for 5P:T
factions.notes: ABOL's state power and its contractors, as one alignment bloc: Harlow 1st Reaction Force (Harlow Kinetic Solutions), UN 3rd Battalion, UN Raid Force Alpha and general UN Forces. Hostile in the Steel Lions BLKOUT conversion. Built from the BLKOUT 2nd Ed. unit cards on the locked conversion schema; distances are BLKOUT inches used as book scale (turn on Independent Action to scale them with everyone else). Two-model BLKOUT units are listed as squads of two cards or weapon teams of 3 so they pass the Army Builder; each unit's notes give the card composition. Generic Handlers and the four Dusters are listed in every BLKOUT bloc. BLKOUT has no transport cards, so a rolled transport stays a generic APC line: use a vehicle of your own or skip it. Infantry points come from the Army Builder formula; vehicles and Dusters are hand-priced.

rules.name: BLKOUT conversion
rules.text: Card Skill sets Reaction, Combat, Toughness, Savvy and Training (Skill 4 epic, 5 Tier 1, 6 Tier 2, 7 trained, 8 militia); KP = armor dice, +1 for a Damage Track; save from the armor number. Skirmish Mode: no cohesion. Casualties use the DUSTLINE Trauma Clock.

rules.name: Control Points
rules.text: Each side starts the battle with 3 CP (never regained). Spend 1 to: use a Battle Drill on a unit's activation; reactivate a Handler once per round; or activate a second unit straight after the first.

rules.name: Armory and Combat Loads
rules.text: A rank-and-file figure may mark one of its unit's Combat Loads to use one Armory item from its force card for that activation (one Armory weapon per activation).

rules.name: Data warfare
rules.text: Data Spike: action, Savvy test — pin an enemy unit or remove a pin from a friendly unit (no line of sight needed). Data Knife: action, Savvy test — 1 hit with no save on an AI or Powered figure in range. Jammer: friendly figures in range ignore Pinned. Counter-EWar: a Data Spike figure may oppose an enemy Data Attack with its own test.

rules.name: BLKOUT weapon traits
rules.text: CQB: re-roll misses within half range. Medium: re-roll one miss per attack. Sustained X: the target re-rolls up to X successful saves. Seeking: ignores the cover penalty. Auto X: after firing, X extra shots at other figures within 4" of the target. AP X: the target's save is X worse. EMP: only harms AI figures, no save. Armory items are one use per Combat Load.

rules.name: BLKOUT unit traits
rules.text: AI: affected by EMP and anti-AI rules. Drone: cannot Brawl, climb or lean out. Powered: affected by Data Knife. Low Tech: cannot be pinned by Data Attacks or targeted by Indirect fire. Shield: this figure and one friend in contact count as in cover. Jump (X): move X" in any direction over terrain. Controller: after this unit activates, activate another for free. Team Leader: may pass its Ready status to a figure that has already acted. Damage Track: shown as +1 KP.

rules.name: Handlers
rules.text: Elite single figures. Once per round, spend 1 CP to let a Handler activate again after it finishes.

rules.name: Dusters
rules.text: Walkers that turn freely. Mobility 3: a shooter who can see the whole base may target Mobility instead of Chassis at −1 to Hit; 3 Mobility hits wreck it. +1 Damage from the rear arc. Fight!: may Brawl other Dusters. May Juke. Never Suppressed. Fire one weapon per Shoot action.

rules.name: Harlow — force rule
rules.text: +2" when Dashing. Battle Drills: Assaulters (no Overwatch against its moves), Chaff (smoke within 6" before activating; clears on a D6 of 6), Stims (+2" Speed this activation). Armory: HEAD launcher, Micro launcher, Frag launcher, Boost Jump (Jump 4).

rules.name: UN 3rd Battalion — force rule
rules.text: Infantry in base contact with another infantry figure re-roll misses with non-Armory weapons. Battle Drills: Arsenal (one Armory item without a Combat Load), Peel Back (2" move after activating), Switchback (smoke within 4" and a 2" move before activating; no Jump). Armory: Shotgun, Corner chasers, Microwave gun, Boost Jump (Jump 4).

rules.name: UN Raid Force Alpha — force rule
rules.text: Augmented: UTG Assaulters and Specialists re-roll one failed die on every shooting attack, Brawl and test. Battle Drills: Close Assault (2" move into a Brawl after acting), Cross Fire (+1 Damage when 2+ figures shoot the same target), Switchback. Armory: Surge, Lance, Micro launcher, Boost Jump (Jump 6).

rules.name: UN Forces
rules.text: Batcon, UTG Mothers and the Raid Team use the UN 3rd Battalion or Raid Force Alpha force card, whichever they are fielded with.
